name: POST /api/leadflow/failures/kill-switch - halt every automated send
description:
Engages or releases the global send pause (4cc3f597-f6c8-4dc5-8044-096ce144e676#AC4). THE LOCAL ROW IS THE AUTHORITY: every send path reads it, so engaging the switch stops sending on the next tick whether or not sdk-feature-flags is reachable. A kill switch that depends on a remote service is unavailable exactly when the incident that needs it is happening.

The upstream flag is set too, best-effort, and the response says plainly when it was not - reporting an upstream state that does not exist would be worse than reporting none.

A REASON IS REQUIRED TO ENGAGE. Halting every automated send is an incident, and the record of why is what the post-mortem reads. Releasing needs no reason: the harm of a slow release is worse than the harm of an unexplained one.

QA: measured live, including the refusal, both directions, and the replay 409 while engaged.

testCases.name: The switch engages with a reason and takes effect on the next tick
Engaging with no reason is REFUSED
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: reason is required to engage the kill switch - halting every automated send is an incident, and the record of why is what the post-mortem reads
errorCases.when: the switch is being engaged without a reason.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
